description: SimuPy Flight Vehicle Toolkit is a Python library for building flight-vehicle dynamics simulations on the SimuPy block-modelling framework. It combines equations for motion and kinematics with SciPy integration and symbolic code generation, allowing a user to configure vehicle concepts and run six-degree-of-freedom trajectories. The repository includes implementations of NASA Engineering Safety Center atmospheric test cases that illustrate expected behaviour. A simulation’s area, altitude and time span follow its configured vehicle and atmosphere, not a fixed deployed route. The source and instructions are public under NASA Open Source Agreement 1.3, as stated in the repository LICENSE text; GitHub does not assign a standard SPDX identifier. It could support studies of aircraft or urban-air-mobility behaviour feeding aviation operations models. It does not model airport queues, air-traffic control or a real fleet on its own. Published test cases provide checks of the framework but do not validate every new aircraft configuration. No directly related catalogue record was established. The repository documentation and licence were read without running the test cases or registering with NASA.
